up: Retrieve the ChEMBL ID and canonical SMILES for all compounds that have been tested against the target with ChEMBL ID CHEMBL5391 (human DNA polymerase iota).
sql: SELECT DISTINCT md.chembl_id, cs.canonical_smiles FROM molecule_dictionary md JOIN compound_structures cs ON md.molregno = cs.molregno JOIN activities a ON md.molregno = a.molregno JOIN assays ass ON a.assay_id = ass.assay_id WHERE ass.tid = (SELECT tid FROM target_dictionary WHERE chembl_id = 'CHEMBL5391')
